## Definitions and theorems

1. [Riemann zeta function](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riemann_zeta_function)
2. [Riemann hypothesis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riemann_hypothesis#mwRg)
3. Attractive fixed point of a function $f:\mathbb C\to \mathbb C$.


## Problems

1. Express the function $S(z)$ given by
    $$
    S(z) = \sum_{n=3}^{\infty} \frac{(z-2)^n}{2^{n+1}}
    $$
    as a closed form function of $z$. What is the largest open disk on which your function is equal $S(z)$?

2. Express 
    $$
    \int\frac{\sin(z)}{z}\,dx
    $$
    as a power series.

3. Show that 
$$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^z}$$ 
converges for $\text{Re}(z)>1$.

4. Suppose I tell you that 
$$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n+1}}{n^{1/3}} \approx 0.571753.$$
Can you give me a good numerical approximation to $\zeta(1/3)$?

5. Let $C$ denote curve that follows the right half of the unit circle from $-i$ to $i$. Set up and evaluate 
$$
\int_C \frac{1}{z^5} dz.
$$

6. Let $C$ denote the positively oriented circle of radius 2 centered at the origin. Evaluate 
$$\int_C f(z) \, dz$$
for each of the following functions:

   a. $f(z) = 1/(z-1)$
   b. $f(z) = 1/(z-3)$
   c. $f(z) = z/((z-1)(z-3))$
   d. $f(z) = \sin(z)/z$
   e. $f(z) = \cos(z)/z$

7. Suppose that $f(z) = z^2-2i=(z-(1+i)) (z+(1+i))$.

   a. Write down the Newton's method iteration function $N$ for $f$.
   b. Suppose we iterate $N$ starting from $z_0 = 10$. What is the limit of the sequence that we generate?

8. Find and classify the fixed points of $f(z) = z(2-z)$
